why: issue 1496 -- arena bytes RELEASED by an entry that was given back and not yet reused, the third reading beside `arena_capacity` / `arena_used`. Upstream has no arena and so no question to ask; here a released region is reused first-fit, so the number says how much of `arena_used` is holes, and an exhaustion report uses it to tell a SHAPE failure (bytes free, no hole fits) from a SIZE one.
